title: Project scaffolding: monorepo, React Vite frontend, Spring Boot backend, MySQL config
story: As a developer, I want the monorepo initialized with React Vite (pnpm) + Spring Boot (Maven) + MySQL connection so the team can start building features on a working skeleton.
ac: Given a fresh clone When I run `pnpm install` in /frontend and `mvn clean install` in /backend Then both build successfully with zero errors
Given the Spring Boot app starts When it connects to MySQL Then the schema is auto-created via JPA/Hibernate and the app responds on /api/health
Given the React dev server starts When I open http://localhost:5173 Then a placeholder homepage renders and API proxy to Spring Boot works
test_cmd: cd frontend && pnpm build && cd ../backend && mvn test
reg_cmd: cd frontend && pnpm build && cd ../backend && mvn test

Given the component library exists When I use Button, Input, Card, Badge, Modal, Drawer Then each renders correctly in both light and dark modes

title: Database schema: JPA entities, repositories, seed data for fashion products
story: As a developer, I want the full database schema with JPA entities and 15-20 seeded fashion products so the storefront has real data to display.
ac: Given the Spring Boot app starts When Hibernate runs Then all entities (Product, ProductVariant, Category, User, Cart, CartItem, Order, OrderItem, Review) are created in MySQL
Given the data seeder runs When the app starts for the first time Then 15-20 fashion products with variants (size/color), categories, and placeholder images from picsum.photos are inserted
Given the REST API endpoint GET /api/products exists When called Then it returns paginated product data with variants
